title: AEM Survey Campaign
description: PROPOSED closed shape for a KFM geology airborne electromagnetic (AEM) survey campaign packet. Governs identity, spatial reference, acquisition state, processing/inversion versioning, units, uncertainty, lineage, EvidenceRef bindings, and governance posture. All stage identities (campaign, flight-line, raw observation, processing run, inversion model, resistivity product, hydrostratigraphic product) are kept separate — a processed or interpreted product must not rewrite the raw acquisition identity.

product_id.description: Stable product identity for this campaign packet. Must differ from source_descriptor_ref — no identity collapse between product and source authority.

source_descriptor_ref.description: Reference to the canonical SourceDescriptor. Must use 'src:' prefix.

acquisition_state.description: Whether acquisition is planned vs. actually executed.

vertical_datum.description: Vertical datum for elevation and depth references (e.g., 'NAVD88'). Must not be absent or empty — fail closed on missing or unknown vertical datum.

depth_positive_direction.description: Convention for positive depth direction. Must be 'down' or 'up' — no ambiguity permitted.

processing_software_version.description: Processing software and version string. Must be non-empty — unversioned processing fails closed.

inversion_software_version.description: Inversion software and version string. Must be non-empty — unversioned inversion fails closed.

raw_source_ref.description: Reference to the raw acquisition record establishing lineage. Must be present — a raw/processed lineage break fails closed.

resistivity_units.description: Units for resistivity values (e.g., 'ohm·m'). Must be non-empty — missing units fail closed.

no_data_value.description: Sentinel value used when no data is present.

uncertainty.description: Uncertainty and QC characterization block. Must not be omitted — uncertainty omission fails closed.

method.description: Description of the uncertainty or QC method.

evidence_refs.description: EvidenceRef-to-EvidenceBundle bindings. Must have at least one entry — an unbound EvidenceRef (empty array) fails closed.

release_state.description: Release governance state. Proposed/disabled records must carry 'not_released'.

correction.description: Correction or supersession record. If present, supersedes_ref is required — silent supersession (correction without supersedes_ref) fails closed.

supersedes_ref.description: Reference to the record being superseded.

survey_counties.description: Kansas counties covered by the survey footprint.

target_depth_ft_bls.description: Approximate survey target depth in feet below land surface.

frequency_system_ref.description: Reference to the AEM system frequency/configuration specification.

footprint_geometry_ref.description: Reference to the line or footprint geometry identity.
